title: effect-size-conversion-v1 task input
description: A single effect-size conversion request: convert `value` from the `from` metric to the `to` metric, across the closed metric set {d, r, OR, eta2, f}. Some conversions (d<->r with group sizes) consume an optional `context` carrying n1/n2.

value.description: The effect-size value in the `from` metric to be converted.

from.description: Source metric. d = Cohen's d; r = correlation; OR = odds ratio; eta2 = eta-squared; f = Cohen's f.

context.description: Optional. Auxiliary parameters required by some conversions. For d<->r with unequal group sizes, supplies n1 and n2.

n1.description: Size of group 1 (for d<->r with group sizes).

n2.description: Size of group 2 (for d<->r with group sizes).
